## Description

Owner-requested export of all clinic data: FHIR R4 bulk (Patient, Encounter, Observation, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, MedicationStatement/Request, DocumentReference, …) and CSV per table, plus original documents; delivered as an encrypted, time-limited download; step-up auth, audited, watermarked manifest.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Export validates against FHIR R4 base profiles (validator in CI on synthetic data).
- [ ] **AC2.** Export requires owner step-up auth, is audited, and the link expires.
- [ ] **AC3.** Re-importing the CSV export into a fresh test tenant reproduces counts.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
